description: [PAID $0.005 USDC per call via x402 on Base; errors are free] Fetch one public web page and return structured metadata: title, meta description, canonical, lang, robots, Open Graph and Twitter card tags, favicon, RSS/Atom feeds, JSON-LD @types, and internal/external links (up to 100 each). Good for link previews, unfurling and quick site triage.
